implementation.int8_tiling: the 512x512 INT8 kernels (1024-row GEMMs, 1024-key attention projections) run once per 1024-row tile at 4096 image tokens; fused host kernels keep their fixed 1024-row shape and are called per tile; results are written into tile slices of one output tensor
implementation.attention: AIR BF16 attention at 4096 keys (self4096 artifact) between the tiled INT8 QKV and output projections; K/V of all tiles must exist before any query tile runs
implementation.overlap: one NPU job in flight at a time; run.start() is issued, host work for the previous job runs on the main thread, then run.wait2() (pyxrt wait2 holds the GIL, so a worker thread cannot overlap)

overlap_schedule.attention_out: quantize(t+1) runs while out(t) is in flight; the gated residual of tile t runs while out(t+1) is in flight
overlap_schedule.mlp: NPU order in0, in1, out0, in2, out1, ...; GELU of a finished 'in' job and the gated residual of a finished 'out' job run behind the next job

implementation.output_slots: per-runner two-slot output ring (slot = tile % 2); inputs are copied into the input buffer at start, so one input buffer suffices
implementation.overlap_gate: ANIMA_XDNA_INT8_OVERLAP (default 1; 0 disables) and only after the four verified warm-up forwards; the verified sequential path is unchanged

configuration.positive: a cheerful anime girl under cherry blossoms, detailed illustration, soft daylight
configuration.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts
configuration.process_model: fresh standalone ComfyUI Python process per variant (real nodes, no HTTP server); the first run of every process includes the four verified forwards

overlap_probe.synthetic: one 1024x2048x8192 INT8 job against three host calls of layer norm plus modulate-quantize

int8_overlapped.run0_note: verification forwards run sequentially, so run 0 is not overlapped

legacy_loader_air_bf16_reference.note: earlier AIR section: whole ComfyUI prompt with the standard loader (not sampling only), so not directly comparable with the sampling seconds above

overlap_gain.not_overlapped: AIR attention (10.19 and 10.59 s per warm run, 44% of the overlapped block time) is not overlapped; the host is idle during it
overlap_gain.host_bound_stage: attn1 QKV: host preparation per tile exceeds the NPU job, so the hidden window equals the host time

memory_gib.phase: peaks sampled every ~0.1-0.2 s during the sampling phase of each run; system total 23.6 GiB
memory_gib.interpretation: private bytes fall by about 1.0 GiB (cold) to 1.8 GiB (warm); the file-backed packed BF16 cache counts toward working set; overlap changed no measured peak beyond run-to-run noise

quality_vs_air_bf16_same_seed.note: INT8 W8A8 quantization changes the decoded image; no visual-quality judgment is made here. A latent-space comparison and multi-seed statistics were not measured.

regression_512x512.note: the overlap path only applies to tiled (4096-token) blocks; the 1024-token path keeps the sequential schedule

boundary_checks: the four verified forwards passed on the tiled path (QKV projections, qkv_prepare, layout quantization, gated residual) in every run

unit_tests.overlap: fake-NPU tests assert the exact start/finish/host ordering, that only one job is in flight, that outputs match the sequential schedule, and that slot reuse is detected (a fixed-slot mutation fails)

limits: one machine, one seed and one prompt; three runs per overlap setting
no CFG > 1, LoRA or CPU-only 1024x1024 measurement
INT8 is not quality-equivalent to BF16; only one image pair was compared
the AIR attention step is not overlapped and remains about 44% of a warm block pass
the installed ComfyUI copy was not modified; its AIR directory has no self4096 artifact
